slides.text: **Human Rights Watch** told an **EU Parliament** subcommittee to press for **civilian protection**, **aid access** and a **credible transitional justice** process.
Borkena, citing Addis Maleda, reports **rival claims** over local administration in **six Raya woredas**; claims are **not independently verified**.
Political.org reports a **US congressman** is set to offer bills with **farm-goods incentives** for **Ethiopia and Eritrea** to de-escalate; **not independently verified**.

slides.title: Back tomorrow at 11 PM.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
